value.text: Got it! Here's the plan for Ada: registration opens Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. (Eastern). Hale will go for Preschool Swim Sun 10:00 first, then Preschool Swim Sat 9:00 if the first is full, each listed at $98.00. The most Hale will pay is $110.00, and Hale will tick the town's activity waiver at checkout. Hale will join the queue right at the open and let you know how it went. One thing to know: if you also queue on your own phone or computer, your family holds two places in line, and the town's queue counts that as more than one place.
